info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Consumer Service Corporate Trust Service-spec
info.description: The Corporate Trust Services Management API enables financial institutions to manage and configure corporate trust services effectively. It allows providers to create and submit new consumer service requests tailored for corporate clients. This endpoint is essential for organizations looking to streamline their corporate trust offerings, enhancing client engagement and service delivery. Typical users include banking administrators and compliance officers who require efficient tools to manage client trust service requests.
